verdict.rationale: Document QnA pairs OCR with an LLM so users can ask natural-language questions about documents, including multi-document queries and comparisons. That is an API-level natural-language capability, not a built-in assistant users hand tasks to; the Agents & Conversations link in llms.txt covers the broader Mistral platform, not this product. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant interface, delegation of multi-step tasks rather than single Q&A, agentic actions on documents, and hands-on corroboration of assistant-style use.
